Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: This step fabricated a hypothetical list of presidential birthplaces and partial coordinates, omitting key cities like Honolulu and Braintree. Per Rule 2, the introduction of false/assumed data at this point set a faulty foundation that directly led to incorrect west–east extremes. Although later steps could have corrected it, this fabrication was the primary cause of the wrong final result.
